name: Valentu the Devoted
bio: Marriage ends at death, but promises persist. When his wife Diana was taken by a curse, the honorable Valentu stuck to his word – he chained her soul to his back and, together, they fight to restore her life.

effects.label: ATK Down
effects.description: Decreases the recipient's Attack stat by the indicated percentage.

effects.label: Deflection
effects.description: Redirects a percentage of all incoming damage from the recipient of the buff to the caster of the buff. The recipient takes the remainder of the damage as normal.

effects.label: Weaken
effects.description: Increase the damage the recipient takes from all attacks by the indicated percentage.

effects.label: Mindworm
effects.description: Disables the recipient's Passive Skills and blocks them from activating.

effects.label: Taunt
effects.description: The recipient is forced to attack whoever cast the Taunt debuff on them.The recipient can move freely, but can only use their Combo Attacks.
